title: Whole Open Spathe and Spadix Plant
description: One newly authored complete stylised above-ground arum-like plant: an upright flowering stalk carries one thick asymmetric scrolled spathe around a separate blunt central spadix. The open bract has a high recurved rear tip, lower spreading side margins and a real open front seam; it is not a sealed pitcher tube or a separate hood over a vessel. Two whole sagittate leaf blades with basal lobes rise on unequal complete petioles from the same small crown. One whole static plant prop, zero scenes. Tiny actual flowers, roots, reproductive detail and exact species are not represented. No growth, propagation, cultivation, food, medicinal or ecological claim.
